#Protest
```{r}

us_protest <- read_csv('ccc_compiled_20212024.csv') |> subset(
  select = c(state, fips_code)) |> 
  group_by(state) 

us_pcount <- us_protest |> count(state, sort = TRUE)

state_pop <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QMbh8F_GFE7wGrPIhgh0LVQjNnyoFL3wAh8dPinaO5o/edit?usp=sharing")

us_pcount <- inner_join(us_pcount, state_pop, by = "state"
                          ) |> mutate(protest = (n/pop)*10000
                                      ) 
#protest colmn = number of protests per 10,000 people over course of four years

ma_pcount <- filter(us_protest, state == 'MA'
                    ) |> group_by(fips_code) |> count(fips_code, sort = TRUE)

fips_pop <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "county",
  measure = 051,
  release_year = 2024
) |> filter(state_fips == "25") |> subset(
  select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high)) 

fips_pop$fips_code <- paste(fips_pop$state_fips, fips_pop$county_fips) 

fips_pop$fips_code <- stringr::str_replace_all(fips_pop$fips_code, "\\s+", "")

ma_pcount <- inner_join(ma_pcount, fips_pop, by = "fips_code"
                          ) |> mutate(protest = (n/raw_value)*10000
                                      ) 
#protest colmn = number of protests per 10,000 people over course of four years

ma_pcount <- dplyr::select(ma_pcount, !c(n, state_fips, county_fips, raw_value))

us_pcount <- dplyr::select(us_pcount, !c(n, pop))

write.csv(ma_pcount, "ma_pcount.csv")
write.csv(us_pcount, "us_pcount.csv")


```
